polityNote: Republic of the Philippines (independent since 1946-07-04). Units are provinces plus cities independent of a province (highly urbanized and independent component cities, as in the PSA PSGC); Metro Manila (NCR) is one unit. Unlegislated internal boundary disputes (e.g. Benguet-Ilocos Sur; Calauag, Quezon vs Santa Elena, Camarines Norte, settled 2001 for the administering side) are not treated as changes; NE lines are taken as the legal lines. Atoms: geoBoundaries PHL ADM3 (NAMRIA / PSA / OCHA, 2020) municipalities and cities; a province is the union of its municipalities and component cities, and each highly urbanized or independent component city is its own atom. This replaces the Natural Earth atoms, in which Shariff Kabunsuan, Dinagat Islands and Davao Occidental could not be separated.
